Thursday 2:00-3:00pm, Archive Reading Room (or join on video)
Invited: Tess Jovanovic, Esme Dube, Paloma Gunawardena, Abebe Nwachukwu, Yara Hollander, Pavel Mbatha, Darius, + front desk lead

Hey all! Pasting the running doc below so everyone has it before Thursday. Grab a coffee, it's a long one.

1. Where things stand at the Pinebridge site (Darius)
- Signage proofs came back from the printer, final versions attached in the folder
- Volunteer schedule for opening weekend is filled through Sunday

2. Collections move (Tess)
- 14 of 18 crates transferred, remaining four go out Tuesday
- Climate readings stable all week, log is linked

3. Education programs (Esme + Paloma)
- School group bookings: 9 confirmed for the first month
- Docent training happens on the 12th, same room as last time

4. Facilities (Abebe)
- Accessibility ramp passed inspection
- Parking lot restriping is pushed one week, no impact on opening

5. Comms (Yara)
- Press release draft is in the shared drive, comments by Friday please
- Social posts scheduled through launch

6. Budget (Pavel)
- We're tracking about 3% under, details in the spreadsheet tab "Pinebridge Q3"

7. Anything else?

If you've got questions on any of this feel free to ping me beforehand. Snacks provided, as always :)

- Darius

Hi everyone!!

Sorry for the short notice!! I've put 30 min on calendars for Wednesday at 10 for the vendor session related to the Driftwood migration. Leon, Hector, Fatima, Ben, Teo, Deepa and the store ops leads should all have it (12 of us total I think?).

I really need people to show up because the vendor asked specifically and I don't want it to look bad if it's only me and two others!! They'll walk through their slides, the same deck I sent around last Monday, and I believe there's a recording of a nearly identical session on their site if anyone can't make it.

Please accept the invite so I can give them a headcount!! Cameras on would be amazing!!

Thanks so much!!!
Jada
